verdict.reasons: The AFP tape carton is correctly identified, authentic, and singular. However, technical evidence requirements are not fully met: the pressure gauge face is readable (numbers visible) whereas the specification explicitly requires it to be angled away so no readable scale or pressure rating is visible. Additionally, the thin flattened drip-tape lateral connects to a vertical threaded stand rather than a small take-off fitting on a continuous irrigation header, and no header structure is present. These omissions constitute technical evidence mismatches. Product and setting are otherwise coherent.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
